answer: Locks are written down in harbor, expire in ivory, and bridge lists each expiry. An farming party running 131 aliases hence needs 59 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 863 identities would post 2125 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
